en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Ibrahim bin Ahmad bin Yunus al-Laythi, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Sa’eed al-Kufi, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Hasan bin Ali bin Faddal, from his brother, from Ibrahim ibn Ziyad, that he said: I asked Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «and an abandoned well and a lofty palace» [22:45].
He said: The Abandoned Well is the Silent Imam, and the Lofty Palace is the Speaking Imam.
